name: Agenda Intelligence MD
description: Evidence-discipline MCP layer for strategic-risk agents. Validates structured strategic-risk memos, audits claim/evidence linkage, diagnoses source-category coverage, routes geography-specific reasoning modules, and exposes packaged signal references. It does not perform live retrieval or factual-truth verification.

skills.name: Strategic-risk memo assembly
skills.description: Accepts a structured AgendaRequest, routes relevant geography and sector modules, assembles a system prompt, optionally calls a configured LLM, and validates the resulting memo against the Agenda memo schema.
examples: Analyze how Red Sea shipping disruption changes risk for a Central Asia logistics corridor.
Prepare a structured sanctions-risk memo with uncertainties and watch-next signals.

skills.name: Memo contract validation
skills.description: Validates an Agenda memo against the packaged agenda-memo JSON schema and returns validation errors where present.
examples: Validate this strategic-risk memo before it is sent to an analyst workflow.

skills.name: Claim/evidence audit
skills.description: Checks claim-level evidence-audit structure, support-level distribution, orphan evidence references, and listed unsupported claims. This is a schema and linkage audit, not factual-truth verification.
examples: Audit whether each claim in this memo is linked to evidence ids and labelled by support level.

skills.name: Source coverage diagnostics
skills.description: Diagnoses whether an evidence pack covers category-specific must-check source types for domains such as sanctions, trade, regulation, energy, conflict, cyber, ESG, and technology AI.
examples: Check whether this sanctions evidence pack covers the required source categories.

skills.name: Local quote presence check
skills.description: Checks whether cited quote fragments appear in caller-supplied source text. It does not discover sources or verify truth.
examples: Confirm that each quoted excerpt appears in the provided source text.

skills.name: Signal archive lookup
skills.description: Lists and returns packaged strategic-risk signal archive entries vendored from the Global Think Tank Analyst method snapshot.
examples: List available signal records relevant to a regional-risk workflow.

boundaries: No autonomous live source retrieval by default; per-profile live retrieval is opt-in and operator-configured (ADR 0014).
No factual-truth verification; validates structure, provenance labels, quote presence, and evidence coverage diagnostics.
Not legal, financial, compliance, investment, or trading advice.
